result:
Admins can now change a user's role from a select in each row of the users table. I haven't run tests, lint or the app, as you asked, so none of this is checked.

- **API (`features/users/api/update-user-role.ts`):** it sends `PATCH /users/{userId}/role` with `{ role }`.
  - On success the hook refetches the users list, so the table shows the new role. It uses `getUsersQueryOptions().queryKey` for that, not a literal key.
  - The hook also shows the "User Role Updated" success notification, per your rule that notifications live in the mutation hook.
- **Component (`features/users/components/update-user-role.tsx`):** a select with `ADMIN` and `USER`, wired into the Role column in `users-list.tsx`.
  - It is disabled while a change is in flight.
  - It is also disabled on your own row, so you can't change your own role by accident. That was my addition, mirroring how `DeleteUser` hides itself on your own row.
- **Mock API (`testing/mocks/handlers/users.ts`):** I added the matching `PATCH /users/:userId/role` MSW handler, admin-only and limited to the same team, so the feature works against the mock backend.

The existing components still call `useNotifications` directly, which your rule says they shouldn't. I left them alone since they weren't part of this task.

There is no `notes/` folder in this project, so I didn't write any notes.
